test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In March 2023, the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) amended the 2015 PFRDA Regulation to increase the age limit for the Ombudsman from 65 to _______ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**70**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In March 2023, the** Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)** amended the 2015 PFRDA Regulation to increase the age limit for the Ombudsman from **65 to 70 years.**
 
• Under the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (Redressal of Subscriber Grievance) Regulations 2015, the maximum age limit for Ombudsman was set at 65 years.
 
• However, a recent gazette notification dated 27 March announced an amendment by the PFRDA, changing the upper age limit for the Ombudsman from 65 to 70 years.
 
• The Ombudsman, appointed by PFRDA, is tasked with receiving, assessing, and facilitating the resolution of complaints or grievances falling under the regulations.
 
• An individual selected as an Ombudsman serves a term of three years and may be considered for reappointment for an additional two years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) **serves as the regulatory authority overseeing pensions in India, operating within the purview of the Ministry of Finance under the Government of India.
 
• Its establishment in 2003 stemmed from the recommendations outlined in the OASIS report commissioned by the Indian government, coinciding with the inception of the Indian National Pension Scheme.
